mapper.select: select config_key, config_value, remark, update_by, update_time from it_ai_config order by config_key
select config_value from it_ai_config where config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.insert: insert into it_ai_config (config_key, config_value, remark, update_by, update_time) values (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{remark}, #{updateBy}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update config_value = values(config_value), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = sysdate()
